CSC 413 [05] - Software Development

Class number: 7251 | Units: 3

Description

Prerequisites: CSC 220 and CSC 317 with grades of C or better. Modern software applications. Object-oriented techniques: encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism as a mechanism for data design and problem solution. Software design, debugging, testing, and UI design. Software maintenance. Software development tools. Extra fee required. (Plus-minus letter grade only)

Class Notes

  • * $13 instructional materials fee.
  • * See University Bulletin or department for concurrent enrollment requirements and/or prerequisites.
  • * In-Person Classes -- Class meets in-person at scheduled days/times.
